meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: Claude 获得通过 Benchling Python SDK 和 REST API 操作实验室数据的能力：可创建和管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等注册实体、库存容器与位置、电子笔记本条目及工作流任务，并能查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据时，或要求操作 Benchling 中的注册实体、库存、笔记本条目等时触发。

say.text: 创建一个名为 My Plasmid 的 DNA 序列，碱基为 ATCGATCG。
say.note: Claude 会调用 SDK 创建实体并返回结果。

say.text: 把编号为 cont_abc123 的容器转移到 box_xyz789 位置。
say.note: Claude 会执行容器转移操作。

say.text: 查询 Benchling 数据仓库中最近一周的实验结果。
say.note: Claude 会运行 SQL 查询并返回数据。

howto.what_en: Claude can operate Benchling lab data via the Python SDK and REST API: create/manage registry entities (DNA/RNA/proteins), inventory containers/locations, ELN entries, workflow tasks, and query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or when you request operations on Benchling registry entities, inventory, notebook entries, etc.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named My Plasmid with bases ATCGATCG.
say_en.note: Claude creates entity via SDK and returns result.

say_en.text: Query the Benchling Data Warehouse for experimental results from the last week.
say_en.note: Claude runs a SQL query and returns the data.
